crossRefs.note: Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the…
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men…
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
“ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

translations.web: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
translations.bsb: The glory of young men is their strength, and gray hair is the splendor of the old.
translations.kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.
translations.asv: The glory of young men is their strength; And the beauty of old men is the hoary head.
